decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted PL/VP/2169/SR/01, PL/VP/2169/SR/02, PL/VP/2169/SR/04
Received: 9th August 2011
PL/VP/2169/SR/03 rev. B, PL/VP/2169/SR/05 rev. B
Received: 30th September 2011  therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The extension hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 306 Staines Road, Feltham.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows, doors or other glazed openings shall be formed in the external walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a part singe part double storey side extension.
